record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.original_question: Let Ω be the unit disc in R^2, fix p>2, and consider the p-Ginzburg–Landau energy E_{ε,p}(u)=(1/p)∫_Ω|∇u|^p + (1/(4ε^2))∫_Ω(|u|^2-1)^2 on W^{1,p}_g(Ω;R^2) with boundary data g(x)=x on ∂Ω. If u_ε is any minimizer or any critical point of E_{ε,p}, does u_ε(x) converge to x/|x| on Ω\{0} as ε→0?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 2.3 ([26, Open Problem 30]). Assume p > 2 and let uε be any minimizer (resp., critical point) of Eε,p on W1,p_g(Ω; R2). Does uε(x) → x/|x| in Ω \ {0} as ε → 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^2 : |x| < 1\}$ be the open unit disc, and fix a real number $p > 2$. For $\varepsilon > 0$, define the $p$-Ginzburg–Landau energy
$$E_{\varepsilon,p}(u) = \frac{1}{p}\int_\Omega |\nabla u|^p\,dx + \frac{1}{4\varepsilon^2}\int_\Omega (|u|^2 - 1)^2\,dx$$
for vector fields $u: \Omega \to \mathbb{R}^2$ in the Sobolev space $W^{1,p}(\Omega;\mathbb{R}^2)$. Impose the boundary condition $u(x) = g(x) := x$ on $\partial\Omega$, and let $W^{1,p}_g(\Omega;\mathbb{R}^2)$ denote the corresponding affine space of admissible maps.

Let $u_\varepsilon \in W^{1,p}_g(\Omega;\mathbb{R}^2)$ be any minimizer of $E_{\varepsilon,p}$ (respectively, any critical point of $E_{\varepsilon,p}$ in $W^{1,p}_g(\Omega;\mathbb{R}^2)$). 

Question: Does $u_\varepsilon(x) \to x/|x|$ as $\varepsilon \to 0$, pointwise (or in suitable function-space sense) on $\Omega \setminus \{0\}$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of asymptotic radial symmetry for minimizers/critical points of the planar $p$-Ginzburg–Landau energy with boundary data $g(x)=x$ when $p>2$ appears to remain open. Partial results exist: radially symmetric degree-one minimizers are shown to be locally stable for $2 < p \le 4$, and global minimizers for related $p$-GL problems on $\mathbb{R}^2$ have been constructed, but a full proof that arbitrary minimizers (let alone critical points) converge to $x/|x|$ on $\Omega\setminus\{0\}$ has not been found in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Radially symmetric minimizers for a p-Ginzburg Landau type energy in R^2
status_evidence.snippet: Existence and uniqueness of a radially symmetric degree-one minimizer with monotone increasing concave modulus for the p-GL energy.
status_evidence.claim: Existence/uniqueness within radial class is known, but symmetry of arbitrary minimizers is not established.

status_evidence.title: Limiting behavior of minimizers of p(x)-Ginzburg-Landau type
status_evidence.snippet: Studies limiting behavior of p(x)-GL minimizers; related question of radial symmetry of generic minimizers remains addressed only in special regimes.
status_evidence.claim: Limiting asymptotics studied but full radial-symmetry convergence for p>2 minimizers/critical points not resolved.
